latestVersion.changelog:
Sticker Pack Generator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate custom WhatsApp, Telegram, and emoji-style sticker packs from any description using AI.
- Supports chibi, reaction, kawaii, and cartoon-style stickers.
- Integration with the Neta AI image generation API (requires free trial token).
- Command-line options for pack size and style reference image.
- Simple installation via npx and easy-to-use CLI interface.
